summary: Independently verified the single commit 9de80e2..60087e0 line-by-line. The invocation command schema now requires a non-empty prompt and target and pins type/kind/subject/dataschema/schemaref consts; command mode emits a fully schema-validated envelope with kind=command, delivery=single_consumer, command identity, target+command-scoped idempotency, and fails before any NATS connection on malformed input; registry routing resolves exactly one eligible fleet-scope target and fails closed on absent/disabled/mismatched/ambiguous routes without leaking profile names; event mode envelope, subject, and output shape are unchanged and the generated selector regenerates byte-identically from codegen; RED evidence (41 failures against base behavior: validateEnvelope not a function, publish arity 1!==2, execute arity 0!==1) transitions to 52/52 GREEN. All four required checks re-run independently with exit 0; worktree clean afterwards; all 14 changed files fall within the declared owning surfaces.

scope.assessment: All 14 changed files sit inside the declared owning surfaces: invocation schema (schemas/bloodbank/agent/invocation.start.json), common-schema example sync (schemas/_common/cloudevent_base.v1.json — only the idempotency_key example updated to the new §11.2 convention), naming/readme documentation narrowly tracking the idempotency and command-mode changes (docs/event-naming.md §11.2 one-liner, README publisher section), the n8n node/publisher (Bloodbank.node.ts, nats.ts, index.ts), schema codegen plus its generated selector (generate-events.mjs, eventSchemas.ts — regenerated byte-identical, not hand-edited), the new shared registry resolver (src/registry.ts), package dependencies limited to ajv 8.17.1 + ajv-formats 3.0.1 with matching package-lock entries, and two focused test files. Nothing touches Hermes stateless execution, contractor manifests, Board Cranker selection, Plane mutation, agent profiles, callback/clone architecture, live automation enablement, or any service-to-service bypass.
